battle.name: 伊拉克入侵科威特
battle.brief: 一九九〇年八月，伊拉克軍隊越過邊境並迅速控制科威特，占據南部通往海灣的通道，海灣局勢隨之升溫。線膛砲（Muzzle-loading field gun）屬十九世紀中期德國諸邦陸軍的野戰砲兵裝置，配置於營、旅級砲兵隊，以不同口徑支撐步兵正面作戰，亦可用於圍城時的包圍射擊。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛砲在一八五〇年前後的德國諸邦軍隊中，編入陸軍野戰砲兵，作為步兵營的直射支援火力，亦隸屬旅級指揮，參與野外會戰與攻城。

countries: 伊拉克與科威特是1990年8月2日最初交戰的兩方。伊拉克以第三軍、第七軍所屬裝甲師、步兵師與機械化部隊從北面和南面越界，參戰兵力通常估計約十六萬至二十萬人，坦克逾千輛，火砲數百門；科威特國防軍規模較小，依靠M1系列、M60B2與AMX-30等裝甲車及固定防空作戰。聯軍階段由美國主導，英國、法國、沙烏地阿拉伯、埃及、敘利亞等三十四國提供部隊或支援。聯軍並非單一國家軍隊，而是由多國地面部隊、位於沙烏地阿拉伯的空軍基地、港口與共同後勤構成。
countriesEn: Iraq and Kuwait were the two original belligerents on 2 August 1990. Iraq crossed both the northern and southern borders with armored, infantry, and mechanized formations from its Third and Seventh Corps. The invading force is commonly estimated at roughly 160,000 to 200,000 troops, more than 1,000 tanks, and several hundred artillery pieces. Kuwait's much smaller armed forces relied on M1-series, M60B2, and AMX-30 armor and fixed air defenses. During the coalition phase, the United States provided leadership while 34 states, including Britain, France, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and Syria, supplied troops or support. The coalition was not a single national army; it combined multinational ground forces, air bases and ports in Saudi Arabia, and a common logistics system.
people: 伊拉克的決策核心是總統薩達姆・胡塞因；阿里・哈桑・馬吉德中將指揮第七軍，蘇丹・阿里・胡辛中將指揮第三軍；科威特國防軍最高指揮官布里格將軍蘇萊曼・拉希迪，則在最初數日指揮撤退與投降安排。聯軍方面，美軍中央司令部指揮官諾曼・施瓦茨科普夫上將統籌作戰，駐海灣美軍航空部隊司令查爾斯・霍納少將負責空中戰役；美軍第七軍由弗雷德里克・弗蘭克斯少將率領，第十八空降軍由加里・勒克少將率領，英國第1裝甲師由彼得・德拉比爾埃里爾少將指揮。這些職掌顯示，伊拉克以軍區計畫執行跨越邊界的攻勢，聯軍則把空中火力、裝甲突破與多國協調分開處理。
peopleEn: The Iraqi decision center was President Saddam Hussein. Major Generals Ali Hassan al-Majid and Sultan Ali al-Khist commanded the Seventh and Third Corps, while Kuwait's commander in chief, Brigadier General Sulaiman al-Rashidi, directed withdrawal and surrender arrangements during the first days. On the coalition side, General H. Norman Schwarzkopf Jr., commander of U.S. Central Command, coordinated the campaign, while Lieutenant General Charles Horner, commander of U.S. Central Command Air Forces, directed the air operation. Lieutenant General Frederick Franks Jr. commanded VII Corps, Major General Gary Luck commanded XVIII Airborne Corps, and Major General Sir Peter de la Billière commanded the British 1st Armoured Division. These command arrangements showed Iraq attempting to execute a corps-scale cross-border offensive, while the coalition separated air power, armored maneuver, and multinational coordination.
kits: 伊拉克入侵主力是T-55、T-62與T-72坦克，配有M113裝甲運兵車及122毫米D-30榴砲；空軍作戰飛機包括MiG-29與Mirage F1，地面防空則有SA-2、SA-3與SA-6。科威特軍使用M1系列主戰坦克、M60B2、AMX-30步兵戰車及TOW反裝甲飛彈，但裝甲部隊縱深和支援火力有限。聯軍集結M1A1、M2布拉德利、挑戰者2、法國AMX-30、M109A3 155毫米榴砲、M270火箭砲、AH-64A武裝直升機、F-15E、F-16C、A-10A、F-117A、B-52G與E-3A預警機；海軍由巡洋艦和驅逐艦發射戰斧巡飛彈，陸軍則以愛國者PAC-2攔截來襲飛彈。主要作戰彈藥包括120與122毫米坦克砲彈、155毫米榴彈、AGM-65小牛飛彈、GBU-12雷射導引炸彈、BL755集束炸彈及AGM-114地獄火飛彈，均在1990年以前已經列裝。
kitsEn: The Iraqi invasion centered on T-55, T-62, and T-72 tanks, supported by M113 armored personnel carriers and 122 mm D-30 howitzers. Iraqi combat aircraft included the MiG-29 and Mirage F1, while the ground air-defense system included SA-2, SA-3, and SA-6 missiles. Kuwait fielded M1-series main battle tanks, M60B2 and AMX-30 infantry fighting vehicles, and TOW anti-armor missiles, but its armored forces lacked depth and sustained fire support. The coalition assembled M1A1 and M2 Bradley tanks and fighting vehicles, Challenger 2 and French AMX-30 armor, M109A3 155 mm howitzers, M270 rocket launchers, AH-64A attack helicopters, F-15E, F-16C and A-10A fighters, F-117A and B-52G bombers, and E-3A airborne warning aircraft. Cruisers and destroyers launched Tomahawk land-attack missiles, while the army used Patriot PAC-2 interceptors. Major munitions included 120 mm and 122 mm tank rounds, 155 mm howitzer shells, AGM-65 Maverick missiles, GBU-12 laser-guided bombs, BL755 cluster bombs, and AGM-114 Hellfire missiles; all were already in service by 1990.
tactics: 8月2日凌晨，伊拉克先以邊防砲火與空軍打擊科威特空軍基地、指揮所和雷達。第三軍所屬裝甲師由北部經艾爾・賈赫拉向科威特城推進，第七軍則由南部越境，控制艾哈邁迪與艾勒・法瓦爾附近的交通節點，再沿主要公路向西北會合；機械化步兵、直升機與突擊部隊奪取橋梁及機場，使科軍各單位難以連成完整防線。8月5日前後防線崩解，8月6日先頭部隊進入科威特城。占領後，伊軍以堡壘、壅塞、掘壕、假的車載發射器與分散的Scud-B發射車固守。1991年1月16日英軍先行攻擊，17日美軍及多國航空部隊展開高密度攻勢，先摧毀雷達、SA系列防空系統、指揮節點、橋梁與彈藥庫，再攻擊裝甲集結區。1月24日美軍第十八空降軍先動，第七軍因天候、地雷與補給條件至30日才投入主力；英法及海灣盟軍同時在北部與東側展開。聯軍裝甲部隊突破伊軍延遲防線後向巴士拉與科威特北部延伸，2月26日第3騎兵師與第4步兵師進入科威特城，27日聯軍控制巴士拉，28日伊軍接受停火。
tacticsEn: In the early hours of 2 August, Iraq opened with artillery and air attacks against Kuwaiti air bases, command posts, and radar stations. Armored formations of the Third Corps advanced through Al-Jahra in the north toward Kuwait City, while the Seventh Corps crossed in the south, seized transport nodes near Al-Ahmadi and Al-Fawwar, and then moved northwest along the principal roads. Mechanized infantry, helicopters, and assault troops took bridges and airfields, preventing the Kuwaiti units from forming a continuous defensive line. The front collapsed around 5 August, and leading Iraqi units entered Kuwait City on 6 August. During the occupation, Iraqi forces dug in behind bunkers, berms, trenches, decoy launchers, and dispersed Scud-B vehicles. Britain struck on 16 January 1991, followed on 17 January by a high-intensity offensive from American and multinational air forces. They first destroyed radars, SA-series defenses, command nodes, bridges, and ammunition depots before attacking armored concentrations. XVIII Airborne Corps moved first on 24 January, while VII Corps committed its main body on the 30th after weather, minefields, and logistics permitted. British, French, and Gulf forces expanded along the northern and eastern approaches. Coalition armor breached Iraq's delayed defenses and extended toward Basra and northern Kuwait. The 3rd Cavalry Division and 4th Infantry Division entered Kuwait City on 26 February, coalition forces controlled Basra on the 27th, and Iraq accepted the ceasefire on the 28th.
data: 可核對的戰役節點依序是：8月2日伊拉克越界，8月5日前後科威特軍指揮部提出投降，8月6日伊軍進入科威特城，8月7日聯盟啟動「沙漠盾牌」部署；11月29日安理會第678號決議授權會員國在伊拉克若未於1月15日前撤軍時採取軍事行動。1月16日英軍先行攻擊，17日聯軍展開大規模空襲，24日地面戰開始，30日美軍第七軍投入主力，2月26日至27日聯軍分別進入科威特城與控制巴士拉，28日停火，3月2日第687號決議建立撤軍、武器核查與觀察框架。美方後勤記錄約有五十萬噸物資及四萬個貨櫃送入海灣，主要經達赫蘭與朱拜勒等沙特港口上岸，再由公路運往前線。傷亡方面，美軍官方通常列為一百四十五人死亡、二百九十一人受傷；伊拉克軍死亡仍有爭議，常見研究區間約一萬五千至三萬人。科威特及其他聯軍沒有足夠一致且可核實的總數，因此不列未經確認的精確數字。
dataEn: The verifiable sequence runs as follows: Iraq crossed the border on 2 August; the Kuwaiti military command offered surrender around 5 August; Iraqi forces entered Kuwait City on 6 August; and the coalition began Operation Desert Shield on 7 August. On 29 November, United Nations Security Council Resolution 678 authorized member states to use force if Iraq had not withdrawn by 15 January. Britain struck on 16 January, the coalition launched its major air offensive on the 17th, and the ground war began on the 24th. VII Corps committed its main body on 30 January. Coalition forces entered Kuwait City and took Basra on 26 and 27 February, the ceasefire took effect on the 28th, and Resolution 687 established the framework for withdrawal, weapons inspections, and observers on 2 March. American logistics records indicate that approximately 500,000 tons of supplies and 40,000 containers were delivered into the Gulf, principally through Saudi ports such as Dhahran and Jubail before being moved inland. U.S. official figures are generally given as 145 dead and 291 wounded. Iraqi military deaths remain disputed, with common research estimates ranging from about 15,000 to 30,000. The available sources do not provide sufficiently consistent, verifiable totals for Kuwaiti and other coalition military losses, so unconfirmed precise figures are not supplied.
cause: 伊拉克發動入侵的直接背景，是1980年至1988年兩伊戰爭後累積的債務、油價下跌，以及科威特增加石油產量所引發的市場衝突。伊拉克又指控科威特在拉馬伊拉油田以斜井取油，並把邊界、航道與科威特在戰爭期間提供的援助爭議合併處理；其中部分指控源自長期爭議，不能當成毫無爭議的單一原因。7月15日前後，聯合國觀察人員已記錄伊拉克在科威特邊境大批集兵，安理會因此於7月25日再次討論。7月31日，薩達姆與科威特代表在吉達會談，最後未就撤兵、油價及談判機制達成協議，軍方遂依既定計畫在8月2日越界。國內政治壓力，以及指揮層低估聯軍反應速度，也是促使決策者採取冒險行動的背景因素。
causeEn: The immediate background to the Iraqi invasion was the accumulation of debt after the 1980-1988 Iran-Iraq War, falling oil prices, and a market dispute caused by Kuwait's increased petroleum output. Iraq also accused Kuwait of using slant drilling to extract oil from the Rumaila field and combined that allegation with disputes over borders, waterways, and Kuwait's financial support during the earlier war. Some of these allegations arose from long-running controversies and cannot be treated as an uncontested single cause. By around 15 July, United Nations observers had already recorded a major Iraqi troop concentration along the Kuwaiti border, prompting another Security Council discussion on 25 July. On 31 July, Saddam met Kuwaiti representatives at Jiddah, but no agreement was reached on withdrawal, oil, or the mechanism for further negotiations. The military then executed the existing plan to cross the border on 2 August. Domestic political pressure and a command estimate that underestimated how quickly the coalition would respond also formed part of the background that encouraged the risk.
impact: 入侵立即改變海灣的兵力結構。安理會第660號決議譴責越界，第661號決議實施禁運；伊拉克則在占領後擴編前線部隊、挖掘壕溝、部署地雷、分散Scud-B發射車，並於9月20日宣布吞併科威特，將其行政上改為伊拉克的一個省。沙烏地阿拉伯提供空軍基地、港口與補給設施，美國及盟國則在「沙漠盾牌」行動下形成數十萬人的前沿力量。聯軍空襲削弱了伊拉克的空軍、防空、指揮體系與重裝甲部隊，但Scud攔截、化學戰劑應急，以及伊拉克裝甲兵在南部地區的抵抗，使作戰不只是裝甲部隊的正面消耗。戰後，科威特軍隊在美軍協助下重建，伊拉克南部設立禁飛區，聯合國觀察團進駐科威特與伊拉克邊界。海灣軍事局勢因此由一次跨境入侵，轉為持續的核查、裁軍與對峙。
impactEn: The invasion immediately altered the military balance across the Gulf. Security Council Resolution 660 condemned the crossing, and Resolution 661 imposed an embargo. After the occupation, Iraq expanded and fortified its forward forces, dug trenches, laid mines, and dispersed its Scud-B launchers. On 20 September, it declared Kuwait annexed and made the country an administrative province of Iraq. Saudi Arabia provided air bases, ports, and supply facilities, while the United States and its allies formed a forward force of hundreds of thousands under Operation Desert Shield. Coalition air operations degraded Iraq's air force, air defenses, command network, and heavy armor, but Scud interception, chemical-agent preparedness, and continued Iraqi armored resistance in the south prevented the campaign from becoming a simple frontal armored contest. After the war, the Kuwaiti military was rebuilt with American assistance, a no-fly zone was established over southern Iraq, and United Nations observers entered the Kuwait-Iraq border area. The Gulf military situation consequently shifted from a single cross-border invasion to continuing inspections, disarmament disputes, and confrontation.
result: 戰爭結果在2月26日至28日明確落地：聯軍奪回科威特城與南部主要交通樞紐，殘存伊拉克部隊在北部據點繼續抵抗，伊拉克隨後接受停火；科威特政府返回，科威特國土不再由伊拉克占領。第687號決議要求伊拉克撤軍並接受武器核查，聯軍觀察團記錄大部分撤軍於4月11日期限前完成。軍事上，伊拉克失去進攻科威特所依賴的大量裝甲與空軍力量，科威特軍則付出重裝甲部隊被摧毀的代價；聯軍的軍死亡人數遠低於伊拉克，但這場戰役沒有處理兩國全部邊界、油田與軍備爭端。停火後的禁飛區、聯合國核查和俘虜遣返仍持續，直接交戰雖已結束，海灣的軍事安排仍未完全落幕。
resultEn: The military result became concrete between 26 and 28 February: the coalition recaptured Kuwait City and the principal transport hubs in the south, residual Iraqi troops continued resisting at positions in the north, and Iraq then accepted the ceasefire. The Kuwaiti government returned, and Kuwait was no longer under Iraqi occupation. Resolution 687 required Iraq to withdraw and permit weapons inspections, and coalition observers recorded most of the withdrawal before the 11 April deadline. Militarily, Iraq lost much of the armor and air power needed to continue its offensive against Kuwait, while the Kuwaiti armed forces suffered the destruction of their heavy armored force. Coalition military deaths were far lower than Iraqi military deaths, but the campaign did not settle every territorial, oil-field, or armaments dispute between the two states. No-fly zones, United Nations inspections, and prisoner repatriation continued after the ceasefire. Direct combat had ended, but the Gulf military settlement remained incomplete.
